result.reason: The revision reaches the fallback by limiting Customer exclusivity to the Deerskin Products and substantially similar-products category for twelve months and providing automatic termination upon HDI's failure to meet contractual service-level, availability, or delivery-date requirements. It leaves the term provision and HDI's reciprocal covenant unchanged, so unrelated commercial intent is preserved. The drafting is professional, though the retained product-scope language and original phrase “exclusive right to use of” are somewhat broad or awkward.
